content: AdaBoost one-round sample-weight update, binary labels and a weak classifier. Start with weighted training samples represented by neutral/blue circles of differing size. Feed weight distribution and examples to a small weak learner tree, which predicts samples. Split predictions into correct branch (green) and misclassified branch (rose); correct branch shows shrinking relative sample weights, misclassified shows increasing weights. Both branches converge to ONE normalization node, then a new distribution of weights and loop back to training for the next round. A separate learner contribution joins final weighted-vote ensemble output. Reserve adequate large slots for correct/incorrect multipliers and normalization formula. This is relative reweighting, not removing incorrect samples. Show no printed labels or math symbols. A clean loop with useful weight comparison, not many generic boxes.
